title: GoldDash
description: GoldDash is a Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mod that introduces a particle accelerator to transmute elements like mercury and bismuth into gold, blending modern science with the spirit of alchemy.
body:
GoldDash is a Forge 1.20.1 mod that combines modern science with the ancient dream of alchemy.
Through the creation of a new machine, the Particle Accelerator, players can transmute elements such as Mercury and Bismuth into Gold.

This mod introduces:

New resources and materials (Mercury, Bismuth, Particle Energy).

A functional accelerator machine that processes elements into gold nuggets.

A balanced progression system requiring energy and special components.

Optional risks and challenges, such as failed reactions or unstable outputs.

With GoldDash, the pursuit of gold becomes more than mining — it becomes a scientific experiment and a race for transmutation power.
